text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back from an outing, I suggest to Oguri Cap that she help out at a store as a way of tackling her awkwardness with groups.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, is this the store? Look at all these regional specialties… They must bring them in from all over the country.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: They've even got some stuff from my hometown… This sure brings back good memories.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Lady A
text_block_list.text: Are you the one who's helping us out today?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …That's right. Thank you for having me here today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap finishes getting ready and heads over to her assigned position, eyes brimming with determination.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is perfect. I'm sure I'll be able to interact with lots of people my age by working here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That said, I don't have any experience with customer service… Do you think I'll be okay?
choice_data_list: Just pretend the customers are people from your hometown!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm… That just might work…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hmm… What should we get?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I want something to munch on…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If you're looking for snacks, I recommend the mochi. They're packed full of fruit!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The tartness goes really well with both the rich bean paste and sweet cream options. You can't go wrong either way.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Ooh, sounds tasty!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: They really are. I tried one for myself just a moment ago, and I couldn't believe how sweet it was!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, you could go for some of these cleat-shaped cookies. Eating them before a race always gives me a boost.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Before a race? Come to think of it, you look familiar.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wait, I know! Aren't you Oguri Cap?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! No way! I went to your last race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You work part-time on the side? Sounds rough, but keep it up! We're all behind you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks… I'll try as hard at this job as I do with racing. If there's anything else you need help with, please don't hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Oguri Cap continues to handle her customers with confidence and grace.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Carrots, huh? Carrots… Carrots…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The customers are carrots… All right, got it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! How come this doll comes in so many different colors?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I was wondering that too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: These dolls bring different kinds of good luck depending on the color. Take the carrot one, for example…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: The carrot one?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The saying goes that you'll be blessed with the opportunity to eat lots of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You'll get to eat big carrots… and soft, juicy carrots too… Mrmgh…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'm not really sure, but I think I just felt a chill run down my spine…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If there are any other carro—I mean, colors that strike your fancy, just let me know! I'll bite—I mean, be happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following that strange interaction, Oguri Cap continues to sink her teeth into the world of customer service.
